title: Leaf rectangles form a monochromatic partition
statement: Let $p$ be a deterministic two-party communication protocol on input types $X$ and $Y$ with output type $\alpha$, and let $g : X \to Y \to \alpha$ be a function that $p$ computes. Then the leaf rectangles of $p$ form a monochromatic rectangle partition of $X \times Y$ for $g$; that is, they are pairwise disjoint rectangles covering $X \times Y$, each of which is monochromatic for $g$. Moreover, the number of leaf rectangles is at most $2^{c}$, where $c$ is the communication complexity of $p$.
hypotheses_covered: p is a deterministic protocol on X, Y with output type α
replaced:
If $p$ computes $g : X \to Y \to \alpha$ with communication complexity $c$, then
$\texttt{leafRectangles}(p)$ is a monochromatic rectangle partition of $X \times Y$ with
respect to $g$ and has at most $2^c$ parts.
